description: Vėjo malūnų sklaida is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. The portal shows the English title as "Distribution of windmills" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. Its keywords include vėjo malūnas, malūnai, statiniai, lietuvos vėjo malūnai, windmills in lithuania, buildings. The listing shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
